description: This Java class provides utility methods for testing LoRa provider functionality, primarily by loading test JSON files from a resource directory.

classes.name: LoraTestUtil
classes.description: Utility class for loading test JSON files related to LoRa provider functionality.

methods.name: loadTestFile
methods.description: Loads a JSON test file from the resource directory '/payload', returning it as a JsonObject. Throws RuntimeException if the file cannot be loaded.
